claimsToVerify: The Laguna Copperplate Inscription is dated to 900 AD (822 in the Saka calendar) and is the earliest known written document found in the Philippines
The inscription records a debt pardon granted to Namwaran and his family, written mainly in Old Malay with Sanskrit, Old Javanese and Old Tagalog terms
The plate was found in 1989 near the Lumbang River in Laguna and is now held by the National Museum of the Philippines
